scope: Fresh H0.1 closed-loop C22 convergence on registry 77. Transfer only SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 incremental local rebuild capability into one Director-dispatched current-main runtime branch, prove exact source equivalence and current-main compatibility, rerun focused control/runtime gates, then stop at H0_1_PASS + C22 SOURCE_ACCEPTED_MERGE_READY without runtime merge.
required_outputs: Canonical IMPLEMENTATION Work Order with one runtime worker maximum
Focused C22/C24/graphical and full regression evidence
Final Evidence Map, Reviewer PASS and Verifier PASS
stop_conditions: Current main moves before evidence freeze without accepted descendant-main audit
Any path outside bounded C22 convergence scope is required
Any canonical architecture/ownership/schema change is required
Production diff equivalence to SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 cannot be proven
More than one autonomous runtime worker would be required
Runtime merge is requested before H0_1_PASS + C22 SOURCE_ACCEPTED_MERGE_READY
risk_reasons: H0.1 is the first harness-controlled runtime-development pilot.
R6 demonstrated that invalid Work Order discriminators or repair provenance can correctly fail closed; R7 must prove the same flow without historical ledger mutation.
Incorrect proxy rebuild behavior can corrupt large-structure presentation while authoritative Construction truth remains unchanged.

design_brief.problem_statement: H0.1 R6 carried correct C22 runtime capability but its execution ledger became invalid because two guarded repair redispatch events did not point to the exact heads reviewed by their evidence. Append-only history must not be rewritten to conceal that provenance error.
design_brief.current_behavior: Canonical main is 4a42c2fb / registry 77. R6 remains a failed historical execution attempt with useful runtime PASS evidence. SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 blobs remain unchanged and the main movement since R6 base is registry-only ECO advisory metadata.
design_brief.desired_behavior: R7 starts from exact current main, uses canonical work_order_type=IMPLEMENTATION and complete allowed paths from the outset, reviews the exact pre-dispatch head, Director-dispatches exactly one runtime worker, transfers the same SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 blobs, and maintains a reducer-valid append-only ledger.
alternatives_considered: Mutate R6 guarded events in place
Create fresh R7 epoch and reauthorize the unchanged capability
design_brief.selected_design: Create fresh R7 from exact registry-77 main. Keep R6 immutable as failed provenance. Perform HIGH review on the exact R7 pre-dispatch head, set DISPATCHED.head_sha to that reviewed head, create one runtime branch, transfer only exact accepted C22 blobs, and reverify control/focused gates.
design_brief.why_selected: It preserves append-only integrity, keeps fail-closed guards meaningful, avoids global schema expansion, and retains the already-proven C22 implementation without importing invalid R6 authorization history.
dependencies: R6 Windows world/core PASS evidence on unchanged C22 blobs
expected_risks: Main moves again during R7 verification
Control-only R7 fixes accidentally alter C22 blobs
Review head provenance is recorded incorrectly
validation_plan: Validate R7 epoch/work-order/event instances against canonical schemas
Require exact pre-dispatch review head equality
Transfer exact SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 blobs and prove 13/13 identity
Run focused harness and C22/C24/graphical gates on R7
Reuse full world regression only if no runtime/world-runner blob changed since the Windows PASS, otherwise rerun
Run standard/directional PC0, overlap, recovery, Evidence Map and independent Reviewer/Verifier before checkpoint proposal

notes: HIGH pre-build review PASS on exact head 72c34c30. Director dispatch authorized exactly one runtime worker. C22 SOURCE_ACCEPTED capability is implemented at exact runtime head 83954a5c and 13/13 source blob identity is verified. Work Order is now VERIFYING; runtime merge is not authorized.
